spec.name: Halloween Lantern Keeper Ghost
spec.description: A kind mint-white ghost with a deep open hood, softly painted eyes, an uneven trailing shroud and a small warm orange lantern. Connected, axis-aligned static geometry with transparent space around the hood opening, arms and lantern handle.

prompt: Kind mint-white spectral lantern keeper with hood and a small warm orange lantern, flowing wispy bottom. Connected static cuboid model x,z0..16 y0..24. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
